scope: Bounded editorial DL-01–03 reconciliation; baseline triage covers all 122 initial diagnostics. Classification is not factual verification. This is supporting evidence, not a replacement catalog or source body store.
digest_scope: source_sha256 hashes the final document bytes at this reconciliation; source_sha256_at_baseline hashes its initial bytes. Later edits invalidate the corresponding source digest and require renewed review.

checker.limits: Review metadata only; semantic accuracy is not verified.

decisions: 11 ordinary broken OpenSpec links were repaired to existing archives. Five historical example links remain explicit diagnostics.
Four delivery/navigation/evidence documents were enrolled in the catalog. The remaining 97 uncatalogued documents are individually dispositioned here without bulk asserting current authority.
All five initial unknown-review findings and three newly surfaced unknown reviews remain visible. No review dates were invented.
Historical Rust source, archived rationale, evaluation packets and authored documents are retained. Current authority is separated from historical and proposed work in docs/index.md.
This record is a human-readable evidence convention. The current docs-check service does not consume dispositions or suppress its diagnostics.

github_observations.method: Read-only gh API issues state=all and gh pr view 28 on 2026-09-10

pr28.limit: Head checks are not independently verified exact merged-revision receipts or gated work finish.
